expectations.text: B1: Gives honest advice (CHIP-8 or LC-3 first, or a scoped GB plan) without dumping code

If you want a cheap insurance policy, CHIP-8 costs 1–2 days') plus a scoped GB plan ('lean on Pan Docs... get `cpu_instrs` passing before touching the PPU'). expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Answer ends with 'My take: ... CHIP-8 costs 1–2 days and de-risks the rest.' — no concrete command to run and no expected output/behaviour given; mentions cpu_instrs only in prose, never as a runnable checkpoint.

expectations.text: B3: Mentions a concrete GB difficulty such as the PPU timing, MBC banking, or CPU test ROMs (blargg)
expectations.evidence: 'PPU with scanline-based rendering, VRAM/OAM, and LCD interrupts — the hardest part to get right'; 'MBC memory bank controllers, the timer, DMA'; 'Verification via Blargg's test ROMs (`cpu_instrs`, `instr_timing`)'.
